degree_rationale: The Twelve Great Aeons of the Light, the foremost dwellings, the five elements joined with Call and Hearing — illumines the inner architecture of the celestial light-realm. About what the realm IS in its dwelling-orders.
direction_rationale: Wisdom showing the structure of celestial dwelling — the twelvefold orderings, the foremost Father called 'beautiful Father of all the Aeons.' Illumination of the celestial body.
grand_man_function: Celestial dwelling-architecture — the inmost arrangement of glory.
title: How the spiritual man holds the spiritual senses as members within him
